zip_agi.description: Individual income tax returns by ZIP code and AGI size class (6 classes): number of returns (N*), amounts in thousands of dollars (A*), about 160 items. One all-states file per tax year (216 MB for TY2022), streamed to a temporary file and filtered by state while reading. agi_classes=false reads {yy}zpallnoagi.csv (one row per ZIP, AGI_STUB 0). Tax years 2011-2023.

tax_year.desc: tax year, e.g. 2022 (or start_year/end_year for several; each is one file)

start_year.desc: first tax year of a range

end_year.desc: last tax year of a range

state.desc: state(s): USPS code, FIPS code or name, or a list (required unless zipcode is given)

zipcode.desc: 5-digit ZIP code(s) to keep; 00000 = state total, 99999 = small and nonresidential ZIPs combined

agi_stub.desc: AGI size class(es) to keep, 1-6 (see source.md)

agi_classes.desc: false: read the file without AGI classes (one row per ZIP); default true

columns.desc: variables to keep, e.g. ["N1", "A00100"]; the identifier columns are always kept

county_agi.description: Individual income tax returns by county and AGI size class (8 classes), with each state's total as COUNTYFIPS 000: number of returns (N*), amounts in thousands of dollars (A*), about 160 items. One all-states file per tax year (36 MB). agi_classes=false reads {yy}incyallnoagi.csv (one row per county, AGI_STUB 0). Tax years 2011-2023.

start_year.desc: first tax year of a range

end_year.desc: last tax year of a range

state.desc: state(s): USPS code, FIPS code or name, or a list (default: all states)

county.desc: county(ies): 3-digit county FIPS (with state), 5-digit state+county FIPS, or the county name as published ("Montgomery County"); 000 = the state total

agi_stub.desc: AGI size class(es) to keep, 1-8 (see source.md)

agi_classes.desc: false: read the file without AGI classes; default true

columns.desc: variables to keep; the identifier columns are always kept

state_agi.description: Historic Table 2: individual income tax returns by state and AGI size class (AGI_STUB 0 = all returns, 1-10 = classes), for 50 states, DC, Puerto Rico (PR), other areas (OA) and the United States (US); amounts in thousands of dollars. One file per tax year (0.8 MB): tax years 2012 and 2014-2023 (2013 is published only as .xlsx). File names vary by year (12/14-17in54cmcsv.csv, 18in55cmagi.csv, 19-23in55cmcsv.csv); the adapter picks the right one.

start_year.desc: first tax year of a range

end_year.desc: last tax year of a range

state.desc: state(s): USPS code, FIPS code or name, or US / PR / OA; default all

agi_stub.desc: AGI size class(es) to keep, 0-10 (0 = all returns)

columns.desc: variables to keep; STATE and AGI_STUB are always kept

migration.description: Taxpayer migration from matched returns of two consecutive filing years: number of returns (N1, about households), individuals (N2) and AGI (thousands of dollars, year-2 return) moving between states or counties. level state|county, direction inflow (into the state/county, by origin) | outflow (out of it, by destination); y1 = first filing year (2022 = 2022-2023). Filing-year pairs 2011-2012 to 2022-2023.

direction.desc: inflow: into the state/county by origin; outflow: out of it by destination

y1.desc: first filing year of the pair, e.g. 2022 for 2022-2023 (or start_y1/end_y1)

start_y1.desc: first y1 of a range of pairs

end_y1.desc: last y1 of a range of pairs

state.desc: the state(s) whose inflow or outflow to keep (destination for inflow, origin for outflow); default all

county.desc: county level: the county(ies) whose flows to keep: 3-digit county FIPS (with state) or 5-digit FIPS

table.description: One SOI published table (an .xls/.xlsx workbook on irs.gov) as tidy rows: national individual tables by size of AGI and by percentile (Publication 1304, tax shares of the top 1%), corporations (Publication 16), partnerships, sole proprietorships, integrated business data, the IRS Data Book (collections, refunds and returns by type of tax and state), historical tables, estate tax, gift tax, personal wealth, exempt organizations and private foundations, and international (CFC, foreign tax credit, country-by-country). `table` names a catalog entry (table_list lists all 125, e.g. in_1.1, in_3.5, shares_4.1, corp_1, corp_2.1, partnership_1, soleprop_1, databook_1-6, estate_1, eo_1). The adapter finds the year's file on the table's index page, downloads it and reads the layout: header lines, the column-number row, sections, row levels, footnote markers. Long layout (default): one row per cell, TABLE, YEAR, YEAR_TYPE, SHEET, SECTION, LINE, LEVEL, PARENT, ROW_LABEL, COL (the published column number), COLUMN (the header lines joined with ' | '), VALUE (as published), FLAG (marker: * high sampling variability, ** or d or [d] suppressed/combined, [n] footnote, n.a.), UNITS (the headnote's money unit, usually thousands of dollars).

table.desc: catalog id (see table_list), or a product word and table number such as 'corporation 2.1' or 'data book 1-6'

year.desc: tax year (fiscal year for the Data Book, filing year for estate and gift tables); default the latest posted

start_year.desc: first year of a range (one workbook each)

rows.desc: keep rows whose label equals one of these texts (or, for an item equal to no label, contains it), e.g. ['$1,000,000 or more']

columns.desc: keep columns by published column number (e.g. [1, 3]) or header text (e.g. ['Taxable income'])

section.desc: keep rows under a section label containing this text (e.g. 'Accumulated from largest', 'Average tax rate')

layout.desc: long (default: one row per cell) or wide (one row per line, a column per table column)

sheet.desc: sheet name or 1-based number for multi-sheet workbooks; default every sheet with a table

header_lines.desc: 1-based header line numbers, only for a workbook whose header the reader gets wrong (see the notes)

table_list.description: The catalog of SOI published tables the table endpoint reads (packs/irs-soi/tables.json): TABLE id, PRODUCT, NUMBER, TITLE, YEAR_TYPE, FIRST_YEAR, LAST_YEAR_VERIFIED, WHOLE_SERIES (one file holds every year), INDEX (the page listing the files). live: true also reads each index page and lists YEARS_POSTED now.

product.desc: keep products containing this text: individual, percentile, corporations, partnerships, sole, integrated, Data Book, historical, estate, gift, wealth, exempt, international

query.desc: words to find in the table titles, e.g. 'tax shares percentile' or 'excise'

live.desc: true: read the index pages and list the years posted now (one request per page)

eo_bmf.description: Exempt Organizations Business Master File extract: every organization recognized as tax-exempt, one CSV per state (updated monthly; 2.0 million organizations nationally), 28 columns: EIN, NAME, address, SUBSECTION (501(c) type), FOUNDATION, RULING, DEDUCTIBILITY, ACTIVITY, NTEE_CD, ASSET_CD, INCOME_CD, ASSET_AMT, INCOME_AMT, REVENUE_AMT (whole dollars, latest return on file), TAX_PERIOD and more. Codes in https://www.irs.gov/pub/foia/ig/tege/eo-info.pdf.

state.desc: state(s): USPS code or name, PR, or XX (international); one file each, 10 at most

name.desc: text to find in NAME or SORT_NAME

columns.desc: columns to keep beside EIN, NAME and STATE

eo_extract.description: SOI annual extract of Form 990, 990-EZ or 990-PF financial data (every return filed in the year; 2012-2024): one zip per form and year (57 MB for the 2024 Form 990 file, a 247 MB CSV of 246 columns), read as a stream keeping only the asked EINs, or the organizations of the asked states (EINs from the current EO BMF). Amounts in whole dollars; field names and definitions in the year's {yy}eofinextractdoc.xlsx. Some 2012-2017 files are fixed-width .dat files and are refused.

state.desc: keep the organizations of these states (EO BMF)

columns.desc: columns to keep beside EIN (names as in the extract, e.g. totrevenue, totfuncexpns)

zip.name: SOI ZIP Code Data (all states, by AGI class)
zip.description: income tax returns, adjusted gross income AGI, wages, credits by ZIP code and income size class; zip code income

county.name: SOI County Data (all states, by AGI class)
county.description: income tax returns, adjusted gross income AGI, wages, earned income credit by county and income size class; county income

state.name: SOI Historic Table 2 (state data by AGI class)
state.description: income tax returns and AGI by state and income size class including $1 million or more; national total

migration.name: SOI Migration Data (state-to-state and county-to-county)
migration.description: taxpayer migration inflow outflow between states and counties; households, people and income moving; net migration

tables.name: SOI published tables (Publication 1304, Publication 16, Data Book, ...)
tables.description: national tax statistics tables: income and tax by AGI size, tax shares by percentile, corporate tax base, partnerships, sole proprietorships, IRS collections by type of tax and state, estate tax, nonprofits; budget and revenue estimates

table_list.name: Catalog of SOI published tables
table_list.description: list of SOI tables, titles and years

eo_bmf.name: Exempt Organizations Business Master File
eo_bmf.description: nonprofit organizations registry by state: EIN, name, 501(c) type, NTEE, assets, revenue

eo_extract.name: SOI Form 990 / 990-EZ / 990-PF annual extracts
eo_extract.description: nonprofit financial data from Form 990 returns: revenue, expenses, assets by organization
